REVERSE.semantics: Bytewise reversal; preserves NULs, high-bit bytes, and spaces; leaves the source unchanged; bounded by the 16 MiB runtime string limit.
REVERSE.coverage: Empty, single-byte, odd/even, binary, maximum-size, over-limit, double reversal, fixed-seed oracle, multiset preservation, and allocation failure/recovery.

SOURCELINE.semantics: No argument returns the final source line count or zero if unavailable. A valid positive whole-number line request returns exact source text; invalid/out-of-range requests fail. LF/CRLF, lone CR content, and trailing-line behavior are covered.
SOURCELINE.ownership: The lexer lends source to the AST only through compilation. Each chunk owns one source snapshot, capped at 16 MiB. VM active-chunk state selects root, internal-routine, and INTERPRET source contexts; per-VM state is isolated. Dynamic bytecode accounting includes the snapshot.
SOURCELINE.coverage: Released caller buffer, blank/comment/high-bit lines, empty program, trailing newline, CRLF, final lone CR content, internal routine, INTERPRET, missing source, VM isolation, and compiler/result allocation failure recovery.

ERRORTEXT.semantics: Accepts whole-number codes 0–99. IBM z/OS 2.5 TSO/E REXX text is returned for codes 3–49; unassigned in-range codes return the empty string. Negative, fractional, nonnumeric, and above-99 values fail.
ERRORTEXT.mapping: Codes 0–2 and 50–99 return empty. Codes 3–49 match the mapping in rexx_builtin.c and REXX_RX22_CLASSIC_DIAGNOSTIC_BUILTINS.md. VM status IDs are not renumbered or exposed.

implementation.DATE: Partial; unchanged. RX22 guest confirmed current-date form remains fail-closed.
implementation.TIME: Partial; unchanged. RX22 guest confirmed current-time form remains fail-closed and elapsed TIME advances from PIT monotonic ticks.

portable_corpus.regina_differential: NOT_RUN — Regina unavailable; no external percentage claimed.

isolated_qemu_guest.assertions: REVERSE text and binary results; SOURCELINE count/text; ERRORTEXT(16/60); invalid SOURCELINE and ERRORTEXT recovery; interpreter responsiveness; DATE/TIME fail-closed; TIME(E) PIT elapsed progress; advancing kernel heartbeat.

limitations: Regina was unavailable; independent IBM-anchored and local expected-result tests were used, with no external compatibility percentage claimed.
REVERSE follows guideXOS byte-string semantics and does not reverse Unicode code points or grapheme clusters.
SOURCELINE retains one bounded source snapshot per compiled chunk; each snapshot can use up to the existing 16 MiB source limit.
ERRORTEXT uses IBM z/OS 2.5 TSO/E REXX syntax message text; internal guideXOS VM status values remain separate.
DATE and TIME current wall-clock forms remain unavailable pending supported persistent RTC policy and independently qualified provenance.
recommendation: RX23 should target the next self-contained portable numeric built-in in the verified inventory, RANDOM(min[, max[, seed]]), with deterministic seed, range, rounding, and allocation/error tests. Keep DATE/TIME live-clock work deferred until the settings and clock-provenance gate is satisfied.
